spans.s:
सौमनस a. (सा or सी f.) [
सुमनस्-अण्]
1 Agreeable to the feelings,
pleasing.
--2 Relating to flowers,
floral.
--सं Kindliness of spirit,
benevolence, kindness. --Pleasure,
satisfaction.

सौमनसा The outer skin of the
nutmeg.

.
--2 A particular offering of
flowers made to a Brāhmaṇa at a
Śrāddha.

1 The blossom of
the Mālatī creeper.
--2 The Mālatī
creeper.

सौमिक a. (की f.)
1
Performed with or relating to the Soma
juice.
--2 Relating to the moon,
lunar.

सौमित्रः; सौमित्रिः An epithet
of Lakṣmaṇa; सौमित्रेरपि
पत्रिणामविषये तत्र प्रिये क्वासि भोः

सौमित्रः; सौमित्रिः An epithet
of Lakṣmaṇa; सौमित्रेरपि
पत्रिणामविषये तत्र प्रिये क्वासि भोः

सौमेधिकः A sage, seer, one
possessed of supernatural wisdom.

सौमेरुक a. (की f.) Relating to
or coming from Sumeru.
--कं Gold.

सौम्य a. (म्या or म्यी f.) [सोमो
देवतास्य तस्येदं वा अण्]
1 Relating or
sacred to the moon.
--2 Having the
[]
properties of Soma.
--3 Handsome,
lovely, charming; pleasing,
agreeable.
--4 Gentle, soft, mild,
placid; सरंभं मैथिलीहासः क्षणसौम्यां निनाय
तां

; (the voc. सौम्य is
often used in the sense of ‘good
sir,’ ‘gentle sir,’ ‘good man’;
प्रीतास्ति ते सौम्य चिराय जीव

).
--5 Auspicious.
--6 Bright,
brilliant.
--म्यः
1 N. of Budha or the
planet Mercury.
--2 A proper
epithet by which a Brāhmaṇa should
be addressed; आयुष्मान्भव सौम्येति
वाच्यो विप्रोऽभिवादने

.
--3
A Brāhmaṇa.
--4 The Udumbara
tree.
--5 Blood before it becomes
red, serum.
--6 The gastric juice.
--7 N. of one of the nine divisions
of the earth.
--8 An auspicious
planet.
--9 A Brāhmaṇa drinking
the Soma juice.
--10 A kind of
penance (सौम्यकृच्छ्र).
--म्या
1 N.
of Durgā.
--2 The moon-plant.
--m. pl.
1 N. of the five stars in
Orion's head.
--2 A particular class
of Pitṛs or Manes;

.
--Comp.
--उपचारः a gentle measure,
mild remedy.
--कृच्छ्रः --च्छ्रं a kind
of religious penance; cf.

.
--गंधी the Indian white rose.
--ग्रहः a benign or auspicious
planet.
--धातुः the phlegmatic
humour, phlegm.
--नामन् a. having a
pleasing or agreeable name;
